notes: Adobe Stock public search has no date-added or last-30/90-day filter. order=creation sorts newest first but does not yield a count of assets uploaded in a time window, and creation dates are not shown on public result pages. Generative-AI share comes from the public filters[gentech]=only URL parameter (the website "Generative AI Only" filter). If that filter does not change the result count, genAiCount is left null.
